product_metadata.title: elabo Stovetop Espreeso Machine and Moka Pot for Gas or Electric Ceramic Stovetop, Italian Espresso Coffee Shot Maker for Italian Espresso, Cappuccino and Latte, Stainless Steel, 10 Cups
features: FOR ESPRESSO LOVERS: The Elabo stainless steel stovetop espresso maker was made for those who cannot resist a full-bodied aromatic cup of espresso. Your 10 demitasse cups Italian espresso will be ready in less than 5 minutes. You can make it at home and no need to make a daily trip to your local coffee shop.

HOW TO USE: Fill the lower part of the three-part Italian espresso maker with water, put the ground coffee into the basket, put the top on and place the stainless steel espresso pot on the gas or electric ceramic stovetop to boil. Your espresso is ready within minutes!
QUALITY: The Elabo espresso maker is made of high quality food grade stainless steel, food safe, sanitary, and durable. Ergonomic handle is comfortable for finger grip and easy handling.
DESIGN: A masterpiece of timeless design, this stovetop espresso maker is a must have for every kitchen. The stainless steel moka pot is a stylish gift for family and friends.

SAFETY FEATURES: The flame retardant handle will stay cool and safe to the touch, and the lever allows for easy pouring. And the safety valve regulates the internal pressure of this pot by releasing the pressure during the brewing process.
